args.body:
Migration report: all 10 batches (400 records) ran. Batches 1-10 each reported 40 records migrated.

Problem: the new CRM saved every phone number with a +1 prefix. The old CRM had no country codes, so overseas numbers are now wrong. Batch 3 validation confirmed 31 of its 120 records are overseas. The same problem should affect overseas numbers in batches 4-10, though those batches gave no validation notes. I have not checked them.

Impact: 14 sales users opened customer records in the new CRM in the last 24 hours, so they may have seen or used wrong numbers.

I have not changed any phone numbers. Correcting them needs the right country code for each customer, and I don't want to guess.

Options:
1. Pause new-CRM phone use for overseas customers until fixed (your call).
2. Have someone confirm country codes from the old CRM, then I correct the numbers with update_customer_phone and log each change.
3. Fix the migration mapping and re-run affected batches, if the team owns that.

I recommend option 2 right away, plus notifying the 14 users. Tell me which option you want.

events.text:
All 10 batches (400 records) ran through `migrate_batch`, and I sent you the report.

The main problem is phone numbers. The new CRM added a +1 prefix to every number because the old CRM stored no country codes. Batch 3 confirmed 31 overseas records with wrong numbers. Batches 4–10 gave no validation notes, but they likely have the same issue, and I haven't checked them. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours, so they may have seen wrong numbers.

I haven't changed any phone numbers. I'm waiting for your decision on how to correct them.
